query:
-- Find all dates with duplicate order values
SELECT 
  DATE(dueDate) as due_date,
  `order`,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(id) as task_ids
FROM tasks 
WHERE category = 'work' 
  AND dueDate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE(dueDate), `order`
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY due_date, `order`;
